description: Get just the plain-text conclusion of an evidence review — the evidence-based bottom line, without the methodology, findings, or references. Prefer this for 'does X work?' questions; use get_review only when the user needs the full evidence, or get_metadata for dates and citations. Takes a slug from search_reviews, list_reviews, or list_updates; a full https://evipedia.ai/{slug} URL is also accepted and normalised to the slug. Read-only, no authentication required; an unknown slug raises "Review not found: {slug}".

slug.description: Review slug, e.g. 'rapamycin' (a full evipedia.ai URL is also accepted)

name: get_conclusion
